# 英文标题: Silas Irons in Need of Help
中文阶段标题: 西拉斯·艾恩斯需要帮助
英文正文: Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, received an important request, but he's been struggling because he's short on materials. I need to defeat Bubblings and bring back Mithril Ingot to help him out.
中文正文: 勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯接到了一项重要委托，却因缺少材料而犯愁。我需要打倒蓝水灵，并带回秘银锭来帮助他。

英文正文: I met an old, balding man named Mr. Wetbottom in the VIP Sauna in Sleepywood. His son's run away from home with a book that's apparently more important to him than his own son?? He asked that I find his son, get the book, and bring JUST the book back. He offered me a nice sauna robe as a reward. Mr. Wetbottom told me that his son, Ronnie, likes to hang out at a tree tunnel somewhere around Ellinia. That's probably a good place to start searching. Seriously, though, just what is in that book of his...???
中文正文: 我在林中之城的高级桑拿房遇到了一位名叫泰素夫的秃头老人。他儿子带着一本书离家出走了，而那本书似乎比他亲儿子还重要？他让我找到儿子，拿到书，而且只把书带回来。他答应送我一件漂亮的桑拿服作为报酬。\n\n泰素夫说，他的儿子罗尼喜欢在魔法密林附近某个树洞里玩耍。那里应该是开始寻找的好地方。不过说真的，那本书里到底有什么……？
别名（|分隔）: A Clue to the Secret Book
